create_TexturesVertex: create a TexturesVertex object with per-vertex RGB features for a batch of meshes
create_TexturesUV: create a TexturesUV object with texture maps and UV coordinates for mesh texturing
create_TexturesAtlas: create a TexturesAtlas object with per-face square texture maps for each mesh
sample_textures_TexturesUV: sample textures from a TexturesUV object using rasterization fragments and barycentric coordinates
join_scene_TexturesVertex: join a batch of TexturesVertex objects into a single merged TexturesVertex scene
